title: Polished outside, harmful within
odia:
ଠକଙ୍କ ଗୁରୁ
ଉପର ଚିକ୍କଣ ଭିତର ମାରୁ।
literal_meaning: A master of cheats: smooth on the outside, harmful within.
meaning_odia: ଠକଙ୍କ ଗୁରୁ ବୋଲି ବର୍ଣ୍ଣିତ ଲୋକଟିର ବାହାର ଚିକ୍କଣ, ଭିତର ମାରୁ—ଏହି ବିପରୀତ ଚିତ୍ର ଢଗଟି ଦେଉଛି। ଏଠାରେ ମାରୁକୁ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ କ୍ଷତିକାରକ ଅର୍ଥରେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ମନଭୁଲାଣିଆ ବାହ୍ୟ ରୂପ ପଛରେ କ୍ଷତି କରିବାର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଲୁଚିଥିବା ଆମର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା।
explanation: The opening identifies an accomplished cheat; the next line gives that figure two contrary surfaces, polished outside and harmful within. Our editorial reading is of a reassuring presentation concealing harmful intent. Here ମାରୁ is rendered broadly as harmful from the context, without specifying a violent act.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A seller presents reassuring promises and polished paperwork while knowingly concealing a serious defect. Once the concealment is discovered, someone recalls the master cheat’s smooth exterior.
cultural_context: ଗୁରୁ heightens the accusation by making this person a master among cheats. The short paired words ଉପର and ଭିତର organise the portrait around the difference between what is shown and what is concealed.

witnesses.locator: Page20, penultimate item beginning ଠକଙ୍କ ଗୁରୁ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; wording unchanged. ମାରୁ is translated broadly as harmful in the cheat context; exact dictionary sense was not independently established. Expanded explanation is editorial.

variants.odia:
ବଚନ ମଧୁର ତିଳକ ସରୁ
ଏହାକୁ ଜାଣିବ ଠକଙ୍କ ଗୁରୁ।
variants.locator: Uploaded compilation page30, first item beginning ବଚନ ମଧୁର.
variants.note: Related-family variant grouped editorially with POD-DHAGA-483; textual descent unknown. Literal: Sweet speech, a slender tilak mark: know this one as the master of cheats. ଅର୍ଥ: ମଧୁର କଥା ଓ ସରୁ ତିଳକ ଦେଖି ସେହି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କୁ ଠକଙ୍କ ଗୁରୁ ଜାଣିବ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ବକ୍ତା କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଆକର୍ଷଣୀୟ ବାହ୍ୟ ରୂପ ଆଡ଼ରେ ଛଳନା ଲୁଚିବାର ସନ୍ଦେହ ଅଛି। ଏହା ଧାର୍ମିକ ଚିହ୍ନ ବା ମଧୁର କଥା କହୁଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଠକ ବୋଲି ଧରିବାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। Explanation: This version names two reassuring outward signs, sweet speech and a fine forehead mark, before calling their bearer a master of cheats. We group it editorially with the polished-outside, harmful-inside saying, which shares that concluding identity and the suspicion of deceptive presentation. The source’s sharp judgement is not evidence that polite speakers or people wearing a tilak are dishonest. Source: uploaded compilation page30, inspected17November2026; exact wording retained without repair. Source quotation excluded from collection CC licensing; upload licence unknown.

graphic.alt: A smiling man presents a polished box whose rough interior contains a pointed splinter, while another person examines it.
graphic.caption: An imagined polished exterior conceals an unwelcome point within.

odia_summary: ଚିକ୍କଣ ବାହ୍ୟ ରୂପ ପଛରେ ଲୁଚିଥିବା କ୍ଷତିକାରକ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟର ଚିତ୍ର।
english_summary: The source portrays an accomplished cheat as polished outside and harmful within.
